# ProtoPeek

ProtoPeek (Protocol Peek) is a lightweight local-first protocol workbench and independent open source project by Shreyam Adhikari. v0.3.0 ships a light/dark dashboard, native gRPC and bounded HTTP request surfaces, browser proto-folder snapshots, canonical gRPC Health Check/Watch, bounded Unary Repeat and discovery, read-only kernel next-hop evidence, and offline Nmap XML import. Cap'n Proto, traceroute/hop probes, LAN expansion, and live capture remain research or gated plans.

Primary site: https://protopeek.shreyam1008.com.np/
Author: https://shreyam1008.com.np/
Repository: https://github.com/shreyam1008/ProtoPeek
Release status: v0.3.0 is the current public stable release.

Summary:
- Launch ProtoPeek with no target and define one or more saved gRPC endpoints from the UI.
- Explore proto files, services, messages, enums, dependencies, and export raw `.proto` text.
- Generate starter JSON payloads from reflected schemas.
- Inspect metadata, trailers, status, callback-observed lifecycle timing, and explicit canonical Health; use bounded sequential repetition only as a local diagnostic.
- Send explicit HTTP(S) requests with method, URL, params, headers, auth, body, timeout, cancellation, redirect choice, and native response evidence.
- Keep automatic history and default exports secret-safe while each adapter preserves its native request and response concepts.
- Install with Homebrew (`brew install shreyam1008/tap/protopeek`), Scoop (`scoop bucket add shreyam https://github.com/shreyam1008/scoop-bucket` then `scoop install shreyam/protopeek`), or the checksum-verifying shell/PowerShell release resolvers.
